steps.title: Prepare 2% CTAB lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 4 g CTAB (2 % w/v), 20 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 16.4 g NaCl (1.4 M), 8 mL 20 mM EDTA, and 400 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (0.2 %) in 200 mL deionized water; add β‑mercaptoethanol fresh on the day of use. Note: β‑mercaptoethanol removes polyphenols, tannins, proteins and inhibits RNase; if RNase cleanup is needed, add RNase only after DNA precipitation because BME neutralises RNase activity.

steps.title: Wash and ethanol‑treat insects
steps.instruction: Collect insects, rinse in distilled water to remove debris, blot dry with a paper towel, place them in a microcentrifuge tube, add enough 70 % ethanol to fully cover, gently shake, and incubate at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to dehydrate and increase permeability.

steps.title: Weigh and macerate insects
steps.instruction: Weigh 50 mg of the ethanol‑treated insects, transfer to a pre‑chilled mortar, and grind to a fine powder in liquid nitrogen using a pestle.

steps.title: Lyse tissue at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of the freshly prepared 2 % CTAB lysis buffer to the powdered insects, stir gently, then incubate the tube in a 65 °C water bath for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL of ice‑cold chloroform to the lysate, mix gently by inverting or shaking, centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 minutes, keep the tube at 4 °C, and transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL of ice‑cold isopropanol to the transferred supernatant, mix briefly, let stand for 30 minutes (on ice or at 4 °C), then centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant and retain the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 70 % ethanol to the pellet, centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C, and discard the ethanol wash.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet in a laminar flow hood for 10 minutes, resuspend in 20 µL deionized water, and store the DNA solution at –20 °C or –80 °C until further analysis.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer; typical yield is ~25 µg genomic DNA from 50 mg insect tissue.
